name: Testimonial Carousel
description: Centered testimonial section: a pill badge, heading and sub, then a peek carousel of pastel-tinted quote cards (overlapping monogram avatar, quote, divider, name + role, and a star rating). The active card centers while neighbours peek and dim; prev/next controls move through.
interactions: peek carousel: the active card centers in the viewport (translateX computed from its offset) while neighbours peek and sit at opacity .55 / scale .96; .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)
prev/next buttons move the active index, clamped to the ends (buttons disable at first/last); re-centers on resize
header items and the track fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms, 70ms stagger)
control hover fill at 120ms; focus-visible ring via --btn-bg-focused
prefers-reduced-motion: track/card transitions off, reveals render in place
